title: Cooking dragons
author: Key-Soft-8248
selftext:
Made this little game in 2 hours with Fable5, pretty crazy ! 

You can upgrade or change your airplane, you hunt dragons, get the meat and cook it for clients.

Like a simpler version of Dave the Diver game loop. 

Need to find how to get better water, terrain and 3d objects !

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Nice job! Is it playable yet?

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: Thanks ! I'll do a few more tweaking and then share an URL to play it :)

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Niceit works! Now you have to get down your core loop. Do you know what that is going to be yet?

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Thanks ! Well currently it's : you shoot dragons, you get the meat, then you can do the cooking mini games and sell sushi from the meat you got , you upgrade your plane and you continue ( and dragons get stronger over time ) 
But I feel that something is missing, not sure what
